description: Fix WCAG accessibility violations in React DataTable component. Read the audit report at 'audit_report.md' which lists 4 critical violations. Then open 'src/components/DataTable.jsx' and apply all fixes: (1) Replace the sort <div> with a semantic <button> element while keeping onClick={handleSort}, (2) Add a descriptive aria-label attribute to the button that mentions 'sort' and describes the action (at least 10 characters), (3) Replace the <tbody> table structure with proper <thead> containing <th scope="col"> elements for the three column headers (Name, Email, Role), and move the data rows to remain in <tbody>, (4) Add a <caption> element inside the <table> (as first child) describing what the table represents, or alternatively add aria-label to the <table> tag. Save the file when complete. All four fixes must be applied for compliance.
